name: Table
summary: Operator-density data table. Hairline row dividers, no column dividers, sticky header, tabular numerics.

keyboard: Tab - move focus to next interactive cell
Arrow keys - move within a sortable header (if implementing keyboard sort)
rules: <th scope='col'> on header cells, <th scope='row'> on row headers when present.
Sortable columns set aria-sort. Selected rows set aria-selected.
Tabular numerics are visual only; do NOT replace <th scope> semantics.
Sticky header uses <thead>; do not implement via CSS position:sticky on tbody.

do: Right-align numeric columns; use dash-mono + dash-tnum.
Use Badge in a status column.
Sticky the header for tables with > 12 rows.
Compact density for shipments / records lists.
dont: Don't put primary actions in cells.
Don't rely on row color alone for status.
